meta.name: refactor
meta.description: Guides a refactor, cleanup, or restructure with the right decomposition. Use when the user asks to refactor, simplify, extract, or modernize code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将混乱代码改造成清晰结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 代码越来越乱,想在不改功能的前提下变得清晰好维护。
copy.tagline_en: Restructure messy code into a clear, maintainable design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your codebase is messy and you want to clean it up without changing behavior.

howto.what: 它会先确认你想改哪里、怎么改，不清楚就问清楚；再扫描相关代码、依赖与测试，把重构拆成小步骤逐步执行，每步都跑测试检查是否出错；完成后运行全部测试并给出改动摘要。
howto.when: 当你要求重构、简化或现代化代码（如用 /refactor 命令指定文件或范围）时触发。

say.text: 把 AuthService 里重复的校验逻辑提取成公共方法
say.note: 会先分析依赖再安全执行。

say.text: 清理 src/utils 下所有用旧 API 的代码
say.note: 开放型请求，会先问你想怎么改。

howto.what_en: It first confirms the refactoring target and scope, asking for details if unclear; scans the related code, dependencies, and tests, then breaks the refactor into small steps, running tests after each; at the end it runs the full test suite and summarizes changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to refactor, simplify, or modernize code (or uses the /refactor command with a file or scope).

say_en.note: Starts the refactoring workflow for that file.

say_en.text: Extract the duplicated validation logic in AuthService into a shared method
say_en.note: Analyzes dependencies and executes the refactor safely.

say_en.text: Clean up all code under src/utils that uses the deprecated API
say_en.note: Open-ended; it will ask what you want changed first.
